name: SM_Ballista_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: ballista, 2.9 m long with a 2.6 m bow: two trestles, a tilted stock with an iron-shod slide, bow limbs in a head frame, the cord drawn to the trigger, a windlass and a loaded iron-headed bolt
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The limbs are plain tapered staves set in a simple frame: no torsion skeins, washers or ratchet. The cord is a 14 mm rope sweep without servings. Timbers are bevelled blocks pushed through each other: no mortises, pegs, iron bands or bolts, and nothing turns or fires (no rig, no animation). Grain is procedural streaking along each member. One convex hull is exported for the whole engine.
